KPhysicalMask.both_tests_full_residual_physical_error.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [MeasureTheory.SFinite mu]
  [MeasureTheory.IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2)
  (Lambda epsilon : ℕ → ℝ) (hLambda : Filter.Tendsto Lambda Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
  (hprod : Filter.Tendsto (fun k => epsilon k * Lambda k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
  (rho : ℕ → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℝ) (hm : ∀ (k : ℕ), Measurable (rho k))
  (hb : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), 0 ≤ rho k x ∧ rho k x ≤ 1)
  (hp :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
      (Lambda k)⁻¹ + epsilon k ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
        Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ Lambda k - epsilon k → rho k x = 1) :
  have tests := ⋯;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have freeKernel := fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹);
  ∀ (T : Finset ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
    (∀ (n : ℕ),
        ∀ᶠ (k : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
          ‖∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  ↑(rho k x) * DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A freeKernel x x ∂mu +
                Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)‖ ≤
            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
              (DReview.physicalBand K n)ᶜ.indicator (fun y => ‖DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A y y‖) x ∂mu) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n =>
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            (DReview.physicalBand K n)ᶜ.indicator (fun y => ‖DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A y y‖) x ∂mu)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
